about_the_game:
When you are staring at the stars, the stars are also staring at you.

 

Tide of Lone Stars is an ADV / AVG with conventional gameplay and unconventional apocalyptic sci-fi narration. As the disabled girl living outside the walls, Blanka, you will meet a strange man, Adrian. An amazing adventure of "Love, Rebirth and Death" is about to begin.

Climate deterioration, famine, war, plague ... It came to the 31st century during these endless cycles of misery.

In 3050, despair shrouded all over the world. Since then, walls had been built and separated people into two parts — fortunate ones inside and unfortunate ones outside.

On the one hand, peace is just an illusion. On the other hand, knell is for the real.

 

20 years later, in the year of 3070, the scarred planet was declared that there were only 30 years for living.

It also meant that ... the countdown to humanity's existence was in its last 30 years.

 

On an ordinary and sunny spring day, Blanka, a disabled girl living outside the walls, meets Adrian, an unknown strange young man.

However, nothing comes from nothing.

The stage is already set, and the curtain has risen. All you need to do is to hold the Thread of Ariadne and make your own choices.

The lone stars meeting in a desolate moment will create a sensation, which can finally change the destiny.

Blanka Yang

  • A young girl living outside the walls who lost her right leg two years ago.

  • She is totally an optimist and enjoys being happy-go-lucky. Most of the time, she sounds noisy. And sometimes, you may be surprised by what she says.

  • Favourite things: oranges and everything related to oranges.

 

Adrian

  • A strange man who suddenly came into Blanka’s life someday.

  • He is a talented but melancholic and neurotic weirdo with a mechanical creation for his left arm — it seems like that he comes from another unfamiliar world.

  • He showed up at the wrong time and looked like in trouble. So Blanka had a bad first impression of him.

Lin

  • A ravishingly beautiful woman who owns a bar named “Nightingale” in the Underground Market outside the walls.

  • She is a close friend of Blanka’s. Because she had been helped by the Yangs many years ago, she helped Blanka a lot.

 

Rayne Rovella

  • A young male doctor with shiny blonde hair and melancholy green eyes who works in the Underground Market outside the walls.

  • He is Adrian’s friend and seems to be hiding some painful pasts.

 

Illya Yang

  • Blanka’s father and a skilled mechanic who died 2 years ago.

  • Unconventional apocalyptic sci-fi narrative and an amazing adventure that explores love, rebirth, and death.

  • 3 narrative sections (Mainstory, Sidestory, Timestory) with 20 main endings and many fragmented stories.

  • The steps to unlock the stories are interlocked, and some are associated with real time.

  • In our special Memory System, there are key nodes, character information, item information, and proper nouns.

  • In our large Collection System, there are beautiful CGs, original music, and 42 specially designed achievements.

This is an unconventional, apocalyptic sci-fi fairy tale about “Love, Rebirth and Death”.

You need to make choices, get clues, and solve puzzles as you are immersed in the stories, which will promote the development of the stories and help you know more about characters.

 

Remember, everyone is the protagonist of their own life.

And the memories from different people may only demonstrate one side of the truth.

Don’t make an overgeneralisation.

 

All the stories will come to their own ends.

And we will meet again at the end of it all.

-此间梦Sono-
